# Xorder

Xorder is a QR-menu and direct-ordering platform for restaurants, used mainly in
Egypt and the wider Arab world. A restaurant gets a bilingual (Arabic/English)
digital menu at its own subdomain, printable QR codes for its tables, and orders
that arrive over WhatsApp or through the built-in ordering system — no commission
per order. The marketing site is this domain; every restaurant menu lives on its
own subdomain.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://xorder.io/): what the product does, features, pricing plans, FAQ
- [Plans](https://xorder.io/#packages): the plans and what each one includes
- [How it works](https://xorder.io/#how): the steps to publish a menu
- [Features](https://xorder.io/#features) and [FAQ](https://xorder.io/#faq)
- [Request a demo](https://xorder.io/#lead): contact form for restaurants

## Restaurant menus

- Every published restaurant has a public menu at `https://{slug}.xorder.io/menu/`
- [Sitemap](https://xorder.io/sitemap.xml): the canonical list of every public menu
- [Demo menu](https://demo.xorder.io/menu/): a real example of what diners see

Menu pages are server-rendered with the restaurant's own name, description, image
and schema.org Restaurant data in the HTML, so there is no need to execute
JavaScript to read them.

## Notes

- Menu prices, availability and opening hours change daily; treat anything cached
  from a menu page as possibly stale.
- Dashboard URLs (anything on a restaurant subdomain outside `/menu/`, and
  `admin.xorder.io`) are private, require authentication, and hold no public
  content worth crawling.
- Contact for anything about this site: https://xorder.io/#lead
